mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals a worsening supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 235 signals elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand expansion regime (GDPC1 > 15000), a positive GDP growth signal (implied by the level) generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 15000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
